title: UCSB XRP API reference
introduction: This reference describes the Python classes, values, and functions that a course project may use. The supplied reference components are working examples; students may use a different algorithm when it satisfies the stated behavior.
conventions: Distances, positions, wheel travel, and range use millimeters (mm).
Linear and wheel speeds use millimeters per second (mm/s). Device timestamps use integer milliseconds; calculated elapsed time uses seconds.
Angles use radians and turn rates use radians per second. Positive heading and turn rate are counterclockwise.
A DriveCommand is dimensionless and each wheel command is within -1.0 to 1.0.
World +x is the reference forward direction and world +y points left. Positive wheel speed means forward wheel motion.

sections.title: Components you implement
sections.introduction: Each student component inherits the corresponding base class from ucsb_xrp.student_api. The base constructor checks the configuration and stores the same object as the read-only self.config property. Robot or supplied mission code calls the methods below; the project class supplies their calculations.

entries.name: SensorModel
entries.purpose: Convert direct XRP sensor readings into measured wheel motion, wheel-speed estimates, range, and USER-button state.
entries.state: After reset(), retain the encoder and time origins, the preceding sample, elapsed-time information, and the recent samples or equivalent state used to estimate wheel speed. Total wheel positions are calculated relative to the reset origins; they do not need separate accumulated position state.

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Establish the encoder and time origins for a new run.

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: First hardware sample after Robot resets the encoders.

returns.description: A measurement at raw.time_ms with zero positions, increments, speeds, and dt_s, while preserving raw.range_mm and raw.button_pressed.

exceptions: TypeError if raw is not a RawSensors value.
requiredBehavior: Prepare update() to process the next chronological sample.
Reset all wheel-speed estimator history so the first reported speeds are zero.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Convert the next hardware sample into physical measurements.

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: Next encoder, device-time, range, and USER-button sample.

returns.description: Cumulative wheel positions from the reset origins, the latest unsmoothed wheel increments, regularized wheel-speed estimates, elapsed time, range, and button state.

exceptions: RuntimeError if reset() has not been called.
TypeError if raw is not a RawSensors value.
requiredBehavior: Apply the configured encoder signs, wheel diameter, and encoder counts per revolution.
Calculate dt_s from consecutive device timestamps with elapsed_time_s().
Do not smooth left_increment_mm or right_increment_mm; odometry uses the measured increments.
Estimate wheel speed from recent samples or an equivalent regularized estimator whose response is set by wheel_speed_filter_time_constant_ms. The exact estimator algorithm is not prescribed.
If no positive time has elapsed, report dt_s as zero without dividing by zero; positions and increments still follow the new encoder counts.
Preserve raw.range_mm and raw.button_pressed in the returned Measurements.

methods.name: estimate_range
methods.summary: Combine repeated ultrasonic readings while rejecting unusable values.

parameters.name: minimum_usable
parameters.description: Minimum number of usable readings required; must be at least 1.

returns.description: Median of the finite, positive, non-Boolean readings, or None when too few usable readings remain.

exceptions: TypeError if minimum_usable is not an integer or samples cannot be iterated.
ValueError if minimum_usable is less than 1.

example.title: Measure one encoder update
example.code:
from robot_config import ROBOT_CONFIG
from sensor_model import SensorModel
from ucsb_xrp import RawSensors

model = SensorModel(ROBOT_CONFIG)
model.reset(RawSensors(0, 0, 0, None, False))
measurement = model.update(RawSensors(20, 4, 5, None, False))
print(measurement.left_increment_mm)
print(measurement.left_speed_mm_s)

entries.name: WheelSpeedController
entries.purpose: Calculate bounded left and right motor commands from requested wheel speeds and measured wheel-speed estimates.
entries.state: An implementation may retain controller state between samples. reset() must return that state to its initial condition before each run.

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Prepare controller state for a new run.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Calculate the next motor command for both wheels.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Requested left and right wheel speeds from DifferentialDrive.

parameters.name: measured
parameters.description: Latest regularized wheel-speed estimates from SensorModel.

returns.description: Normalized left and right motor commands bounded by config.max_drive_command.

exceptions: TypeError if target or measured is not a WheelSpeeds value.
requiredBehavior: Return an exact zero command for a wheel whose requested speed is zero.
Keep each command within plus or minus config.max_drive_command.
For a nonzero requested speed, a larger speed error in the requested direction must produce a stronger command than a smaller error under the same conditions.

entries.name: DifferentialDrive
entries.purpose: Convert requested robot forward speed and turn rate into target left and right wheel speeds.
entries.state: Each calculation is independent; the component does not need to retain state between calls.

methods.name: wheel_speeds
methods.summary: Calculate target wheel speeds for one body-motion request.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Requested forward speed and counterclockwise turn rate.

returns.description: Target left and right wheel speeds in mm/s.

exceptions: TypeError if command is not a MotionCommand value.
requiredBehavior: For track width b, forward speed v, and turn rate omega, return left speed v - omega*b/2 and right speed v + omega*b/2.
Positive turn rate therefore requests a faster right wheel than left wheel.

entries.name: Odometry
entries.purpose: Update the estimated world position and heading from measured left and right wheel travel.
entries.state: After reset(), retain the latest Pose. Simulator ground-truth position is not an input.

properties.name: pose
properties.description: Latest estimated pose; available after reset().

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Set the pose for a new run.
exceptions: TypeError if initial_pose is not a Pose value.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Integrate one differential-drive wheel-travel increment.

parameters.name: left_increment_mm
parameters.description: Signed left-wheel travel since the preceding sample.

parameters.name: right_increment_mm
parameters.description: Signed right-wheel travel since the preceding sample.

returns.description: Updated pose with heading wrapped to [-pi, pi).

exceptions: RuntimeError if reset() has not been called.
TypeError for Boolean or nonnumeric increments.
requiredBehavior: Use d=(left_increment_mm+right_increment_mm)/2 and dtheta=(right_increment_mm-left_increment_mm)/track_width_mm.
For dtheta equal to zero, translate by d at the current heading.
For nonzero dtheta, integrate the exact constant-curvature arc: radius=d/dtheta, dx=radius*(sin(theta+dtheta)-sin(theta)), and dy=-radius*(cos(theta+dtheta)-cos(theta)).
Retain and return the new pose.

entries.name: NavigationController
entries.purpose: Generate motion commands that visit an ordered sequence of world-coordinate goals.
entries.state: Retain the ordered goals, the active goal, completion state, and any turn/drive/realignment phase used by the implementation.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Store an ordered goal sequence and begin navigation.

parameters.name: goals
parameters.description: Tuple or list of navigation goals in visit order; it may be empty.

requiredBehavior: An empty goal sequence is immediately complete; current_goal() returns None and update() returns STOP_COMMAND.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Calculate the next motion request from the latest odometry pose.

returns.description: Forward-speed and turn-rate request for the next Robot step.

requiredBehavior: Use wrap-safe heading errors.
Turn toward a goal before driving forward when the heading error is large.
Use approach speed within config.slowdown_distance_mm of the goal and realign if the heading error grows beyond config.realign_heading_rad.
Visit goals in their supplied order. A goal with heading_rad=None requires position only; a numerical final heading must also be reached.
After all goals are complete, return STOP_COMMAND.

methods.name: current_goal
methods.summary: Return the active goal, or None after completion.

methods.name: is_complete
methods.summary: Report whether every required position and heading is complete.

returns.description: True only after the complete goal sequence has been reached.

entries.name: GridPlanner
entries.purpose: Find a connected route through free cells in an occupancy grid.
entries.state: Search state may remain local to each plan() call.

methods.name: plan
methods.signature: plan(grid: OccupancyGrid, start: GridCell | None, goal: GridCell | None) -> GridPath | None
methods.summary: Find a valid connected route from the start cell to the goal cell.

parameters.name: grid
parameters.description: Map of free and blocked cells.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Starting cell, or None when the position lies outside the grid.

parameters.name: goal
parameters.description: Destination cell, or None when the position lies outside the grid.

returns.description: A route including both endpoints, or None when an endpoint is unavailable or blocked or no route exists.

requiredBehavior: Use only free cells and move between cells that share a horizontal or vertical edge.
Any route that connects the endpoints through free edge-adjacent cells is accepted.

sections.title: Robot services
sections.introduction: Use Robot for ordinary course programs. It assembles the selected components into the timed robot control cycle.

entries.name: Robot
entries.purpose: Run the timed measurement, motor-control, odometry, telemetry, and live-parameter cycle.
entries.state: Retains the selected components, latest RobotState, next absolute sample deadline, and latest timing overrun. Projects normally obtain a configured instance with make_robot(ROBOT_CONFIG).
entries.signature: Robot(config, bot, sensor_model, wheel_controller, differential_drive, odometry)

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Timing, geometry, calibration, gains, and limits.

properties.name: state
properties.description: Latest state; raises RuntimeError before start().

properties.name: last_overrun_ms
properties.description: Amount by which the latest calculation exceeded its sample deadline, or zero.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Reset encoders and components and begin a run.
requiredBehavior: An IDE-managed Run begins immediately. A project launched directly on the XRP waits for the USER button.

methods.name: step
methods.signature: step(command: MotionCommand, read_range: bool = False) -> RobotState
methods.summary: Execute one complete robot control cycle.

parameters.name: read_range
parameters.description: Request an ultrasonic reading for this sample.

requiredBehavior: Stops the motors before re-raising an exception from the cycle.
Maintains the configured absolute sample schedule; do not add sleep_ms() inside the control loop.

methods.name: estimate_range
methods.summary: Use the selected SensorModel to combine range readings.

parameters.name: minimum_usable
parameters.description: Minimum number of usable readings required.

returns.description: Range estimate in mm, or None.

methods.name: stop
methods.summary: Stop both motors and publish a zero drive command.

entries.name: StraightLineController
entries.purpose: Request cruise, approach, or zero forward speed from measured mean wheel travel.
entries.state: Retains the starting mean wheel position, requested distance, and completion state.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Cruise and approach speeds, slowdown distance, and position tolerance.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Begin a nonnegative forward move from the current mean wheel position.

parameters.name: measurements
parameters.description: Measurements at the beginning of the move.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Return cruise, approach, or stop command from remaining distance.

methods.name: is_complete
methods.summary: Report whether the distance is within the position tolerance.

sections.title: Data types
sections.introduction: These validated values carry information between components. Their public fields are read-only.

entries.name: RawSensors
entries.purpose: Store one direct hardware sample.

properties.name: left_encoder_count
properties.description: Left encoder count relative to the latest reset.

properties.name: right_encoder_count
properties.description: Right encoder count relative to the latest reset.

properties.name: range_mm
properties.description: Ultrasonic range, or None when unavailable or not requested.

entries.name: Measurements
entries.purpose: Store sensor-derived motion and range values for one sample.
entries.signature: Measurements(time_ms, dt_s, left_position_mm, right_position_mm, left_increment_mm, right_increment_mm, left_speed_mm_s, right_speed_mm_s, range_mm, button_pressed)

properties.name: dt_s
properties.description: Elapsed time from the preceding sample.

properties.name: left_increment_mm
properties.description: Unsmoothed left-wheel travel since the preceding sample.

properties.name: right_increment_mm
properties.description: Unsmoothed right-wheel travel since the preceding sample.

properties.name: wheel_speeds
properties.description: Left and right speed estimates as one value.

entries.name: WheelSpeeds
entries.purpose: Store left and right wheel speeds.

entries.name: MotionCommand
entries.purpose: Store requested robot-body motion.

entries.name: DriveCommand
entries.purpose: Store normalized left and right motor commands before hardware sign conversion.
notes: MotorEfforts is a compatibility name for the same type. Use DriveCommand in new code.

entries.name: Pose
entries.purpose: Store estimated position and heading in world coordinates.

entries.name: RobotState
entries.purpose: Pair the measurements and odometry pose returned by one robot sample.

entries.name: NavigationGoal
entries.purpose: Store a destination position and optional required heading.

properties.name: heading_rad
properties.description: Required final heading, or None for position only.

entries.name: GridCell
entries.purpose: Store one integer occupancy-grid coordinate.

entries.name: GridPath
entries.purpose: Store an ordered route of edge-adjacent grid cells.

properties.name: cells
properties.description: Nonempty route of horizontally or vertically adjacent cells.

methods.name: to_goals
methods.signature: to_goals(grid: OccupancyGrid, final_heading_rad: float | None = None) -> tuple[NavigationGoal, ...]
methods.summary: Convert the route to compact goals at turns and the final cell.

parameters.name: grid
parameters.description: Grid used to convert cell centers to world coordinates.

parameters.name: final_heading_rad
parameters.description: Optional heading required at the final goal.

entries.name: STOP_COMMAND
entries.purpose: Shared zero-motion request.

sections.title: Configuration
sections.introduction: Configuration records validate their values at construction and then expose read-only fields. Construct a new record in robot_config.py when a setting changes.

entries.name: RobotConfig
entries.purpose: Store robot timing, geometry, signs, motor calibration, wheel-speed estimator response, feedback gain, and command limit.
entries.signature: RobotConfig(sample_period_ms=20, wheel_diameter_mm=60.0, encoder_counts_per_revolution=585.0, track_width_mm=155.0, left_motor_sign=1, right_motor_sign=1, left_encoder_sign=1, right_encoder_sign=1, left_start_command=0.0, right_start_command=0.0, left_speed_command_gain=0.0, right_speed_command_gain=0.0, wheel_speed_filter_time_constant_ms=80.0, wheel_speed_kp=0.0, max_drive_command=1.0)

properties.name: encoder_counts_per_revolution
properties.description: Encoder counts for one wheel revolution; positive.

properties.name: track_width_mm
properties.description: Effective separation between wheel paths used by drive and odometry calculations; positive.

properties.name: left_motor_sign
properties.description: +1 or -1 so positive logical command drives the left wheel forward.

properties.name: right_motor_sign
properties.description: +1 or -1 so positive logical command drives the right wheel forward.

properties.name: left_encoder_sign
properties.description: +1 or -1 so forward left-wheel travel is positive.

properties.name: right_encoder_sign
properties.description: +1 or -1 so forward right-wheel travel is positive.

properties.name: left_start_command
properties.description: Nonnegative left command used to overcome motor deadband.

properties.name: right_start_command
properties.description: Nonnegative right command used to overcome motor deadband.

properties.name: left_speed_command_gain
properties.description: Left feedforward command per requested wheel speed.

properties.name: right_speed_command_gain
properties.description: Right feedforward command per requested wheel speed.

properties.name: wheel_speed_filter_time_constant_ms
properties.description: Response time of the encoder-derived wheel-speed estimate; zero disables regularization.

properties.name: wheel_speed_kp
properties.description: Proportional motor-command correction per wheel-speed error.

notes: For compatibility with projects created before API 0.3, the implementation also accepts the older argument names ending in _effort. New projects should use the names above.

entries.name: NavigationConfig
entries.purpose: Store speeds, distances, angular rates, and tolerances used by supplied straight-line and student navigation controllers.
entries.signature: NavigationConfig(cruise_speed_mm_s, approach_speed_mm_s, slowdown_distance_mm, turn_rate_rad_s, position_tolerance_mm, heading_tolerance_rad, realign_heading_rad)

properties.name: approach_speed_mm_s
properties.description: Reduced speed near a goal; positive and no greater than cruise speed.

properties.name: slowdown_distance_mm
properties.description: Distance at which approach speed begins; positive.

properties.name: realign_heading_rad
properties.description: Heading-error magnitude that triggers realignment; no smaller than heading tolerance.

sections.title: Live controls and telemetry values
sections.introduction: Import ucsb_xrp.live to create compact controls and publish selected program values to the Monitor. Declare controls once, then read each LiveParameter.value during the robot loop. Robot applies pending changes at sample boundaries.

entries.name: ucsb_xrp.live
entries.purpose: Create Monitor controls and publish selected program values.

entries.name: LiveParameter
entries.purpose: Represent one Monitor control and the value currently applied to the program.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Value currently applied to the program; read it but do not assign to it.

properties.name: options
properties.description: Choice values, or an empty tuple.

entries.name: live.number
entries.purpose: Declare a bounded numeric slider.
entries.signature: live.number(name, default, minimum, maximum, step, unit='', label=None) -> LiveParameter

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique Python-style identifier, at most 32 characters.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

requiredBehavior: maximum must exceed minimum; step must be positive and no larger than the range; default must lie inside the inclusive bounds.
The range does not need to contain an exact whole number of steps. The applied value is the nearest available step within the bounds.

entries.name: live.toggle
entries.purpose: Declare an on/off control.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

entries.name: live.choice
entries.purpose: Declare a control with two to six string choices.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Initial applied choice; it must appear in options.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

entries.name: live.watch
entries.purpose: Publish the latest number, Boolean, or short string as a named live value.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Finite number, Boolean, or string of at most 64 characters.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

entries.name: live.plot
entries.purpose: Publish a finite numeric value as an optional Monitor strip-plot signal.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Finite numeric value for the current sample.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

entries.name: live.apply_updates
entries.purpose: Apply the latest Monitor control values at one program boundary.

returns.description: True if at least one applied value changed.

notes: Robot.start() and Robot.step() call this automatically. Call it directly only in a program that does not use Robot.

entries.name: ProjectWorld
entries.purpose: Provide one validated world from the project's world.json file.

methods.name: arena_map
methods.summary: Build an arena map with selected features blocked.

parameters.name: blocked_features
parameters.description: Feature names that should act as obstacles.

methods.name: waypoint
methods.summary: Return one named waypoint.

methods.name: waypoints
methods.summary: Return all waypoints in file order.

entries.name: load_world
entries.purpose: Load the default or named world from a project JSON file.

entries.name: Rectangle
entries.purpose: Represent a closed axis-aligned rectangle in world millimeters.

properties.name: maximum_x_mm
properties.description: Maximum x boundary; greater than minimum_x_mm.

properties.name: maximum_y_mm
properties.description: Maximum y boundary; greater than minimum_y_mm.

properties.name: bounds_mm
properties.description: Minimum and maximum x and y bounds.

methods.name: contains
methods.summary: Test whether a point lies inside bounds expanded by margin_mm.

entries.name: ArenaMap
entries.purpose: Represent rectangular arena bounds, fixed obstacles, and named changeable obstacle features.

parameters.name: bounds_mm
parameters.description: Arena bounds as a Rectangle or four-number bounds.

parameters.name: blocked_features
parameters.description: Feature names initially treated as obstacles.

methods.name: feature_bounds
methods.signature: feature_bounds(name: str) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]
methods.summary: Return one feature's bounds.

methods.name: contains
methods.summary: Test whether a point lies inside the arena.

returns.description: True inside or on the arena boundary.

methods.name: is_free
methods.summary: Test arena and obstacle clearance.

parameters.name: clearance_mm
parameters.description: Required nonnegative distance from walls and obstacles.

returns.description: True when the point satisfies the requested clearance.

methods.name: with_feature_blocked
methods.summary: Return a new map with one feature's blocked state changed.

parameters.name: blocked
parameters.description: Whether the feature should act as an obstacle.

entries.name: OccupancyGrid
entries.purpose: Sample an ArenaMap into uniform free and blocked cells.
entries.signature: OccupancyGrid.from_arena(arena: ArenaMap, resolution_mm: float, clearance_mm: float = 0.0) -> OccupancyGrid

methods.name: world_to_cell
methods.summary: Convert a world point to a cell or None outside the grid.

returns.description: Containing cell, or None outside the grid.

methods.name: cell_center
methods.summary: Return a cell center in world millimeters.

returns.description: World x and y coordinates in millimeters.

methods.name: contains
methods.summary: Test whether a cell is inside the grid.

returns.description: True when row and column are in bounds.

methods.name: is_blocked
methods.summary: Report blocked state; cells outside the grid are blocked.

methods.name: neighbors
methods.summary: Return free cells sharing a horizontal or vertical edge.

returns.description: Free edge-adjacent cells in deterministic order.

notes: For direct software tests, the full constructor accepts resolution_mm, origin_x_mm, origin_y_mm, column_count, row_count, and row-major blocked values. Course projects normally use from_arena().

entries.name: DeliveryTask
entries.purpose: Store the fixed values needed for one supplied delivery mission.
entries.signature: DeliveryTask(initial_pose, arena, grid_resolution_mm, clearance_mm, destination, observed_feature_name, range_sample_count, minimum_usable_range_count, blocked_range_threshold_mm, assume_blocked_without_range)

properties.name: arena

properties.description: Delivery destination and optional final heading.

properties.name: observed_feature_name
properties.description: Arena feature classified by the range observation.

properties.name: range_sample_count
properties.description: Positive number of range samples to collect.

properties.name: minimum_usable_range_count
properties.description: Positive minimum usable readings, no greater than range_sample_count.

properties.name: blocked_range_threshold_mm
properties.description: Positive range at or below which the observed feature is treated as blocked.

properties.name: assume_blocked_without_range
properties.description: Blocked state used when no range estimate is available.

entries.name: DeliveryMission
entries.purpose: Perform range observation, map update, route planning, and navigation for a DeliveryTask.
entries.signature: DeliveryMission(task: DeliveryTask, navigation: NavigationController, planner: GridPlanner)

properties.name: result
properties.description: delivered, no_path, or None before completion.

methods.name: run
methods.summary: Run the supplied delivery sequence and always attempt robot.stop().
